_comment: Tracks real, popularity-weighted OSS Terraform/OpenTofu estates run through the five-stage crossing pipeline (cold deploy -> migrate -> test plan -> test apply -> drift and reconverge), same spirit as cohort-acceptance.json but for real-world estates rather than estate-gen's synthetic cohorts. A stage is 'pass', 'fail', or 'not_run' - not_run means the estate's script does not yet exercise that stage, which is itself a gap worth closing, not a silent pass. Updated by the orchestrator from each crossing's own verified run, not by an agent editing this file directly - the same discipline live/cohort-acceptance.json uses, so N concurrent crossings never fight over one JSON file's sort order.

estates.source: hand-written reference project: the plainest getting-started shape (VPC/subnet/SG/IGW/EC2)
estates.notes: Verified end-to-end 2026-08-17/18. Predates the drift-and-reconverge stage being added to the pipeline shape; needs a follow-up pass to add it, same as every other pre-existing corpus-* script.

Landed f6a9f899d0 (2026-08-18), which also fixed a real generalizing bug on the way: live-import's Ratify loop skipped every resource inside a module block (regressed behind closed issue #59's child-module admission, which named five other root-only walkers but never live-import). module.lambda_function.{aws_lambda_function,aws_iam_role,aws_cloudwatch_log_group} now stamp correctly - this affects every real module usage, not just this estate, since virtually all published Terraform modules nest their resources under a module block. test_plan blocked on a separate, still-open gap: two resource blocks (aws_lambda_function_url, aws_lambda_function_recursion_config) use count = var.enable_x ? 1 : 0 with the var false/unset, so stock OpenTofu creates zero instances of either, but choudoufu's type-admission check runs per declared block rather than per resolved instance and refuses the plan outright. A local_file resource is also refused (outside the live-markers subset). Filed as #303. Recommended next slot: a static count-is-zero evaluator feeding type admission - likely high-leverage, since count-gated optional-feature resources are an extremely common module idiom, not specific to this one.

Landed c239792018/47778a931a (2026-08-18). Crossed by an agent whose worktree predated the lambda-simple crossing's live-import child-module fix (cec3c4b9b1) - migrate is recorded fail here because that's what the agent's own base observed, but since cec3c4b9b1 is now on main and fixes exactly this class of defect (root-only walker in live-import's Ratify loop) for all 39 of this estate's resources (all module-nested), migrate needs re-verification against current main before trusting this row's fail as still current. Even if migrate now passes, test_plan is independently blocked by two newly-filed, distinct defects this crossing also found: #304 (count-index-in-tag can't trace a static lookup() into terraform-aws-security-group's own bundled rules table - 7 of 35 refusals) and #305 (aws_default_network_acl/aws_default_route_table/aws_default_security_group are unadmitted types, from terraform-aws-vpc's default-object adoption pattern). Two unrelated real floci gaps found and filed upstream on the fork: lex00/floci#51 (RDS cross-region backup replication), lex00/floci#52 (SecretsManager RotateSecret wrongly requires a Lambda ARN for RDS-managed rotation) - both worked around in the script with documented EMULATOR GAP deltas so stage 1 could stand up at all.

estates.source: terraform-aws-modules/terraform-aws-vpc examples/complete (tag v6.6.1), its flagship example
estates.notes: Landed 9b75cae5ce (2026-08-18). Two real, distinct fixes landed on the way: (1) a floci gap where DescribeVpcEndpointServices always answered empty, blocking every VPC endpoint regardless of service - fixed on the fork (lex00/floci commit 83e44fe6, reconciled into the combined image the orchestrator is republishing) and (2) closed #303 outright (see that issue) via the new generically-derived blockHasNoInstances, hit here through the same terraform-aws-vpc default-object-adoption pattern #305 already named. cold_deploy still fails on floci gaps this crossing judged out of scope for the session rather than sprawling into: Redshift has no service in floci at all (CreateClusterSubnetGroup), plus CreateDhcpOptions, CreateCacheSubnetGroup (ElastiCache) and CreateCustomerGateway/CreateVpnGateway all return UnsupportedOperation with no implementation in floci's Java source. Stages 2-5 are implemented in the script (live-import adoption, empty replan with rendered-identity assertions, no-op apply, drift-and-reconverge on a subnet tag, BREAK=1 controls) but unexercised since stage 1 fails fast by design.
